scope: Actual Chromium UI/canvas/workers, simulated localStorage, captured download blobs. Not external CAM, hosted offline behavior or manufacturer acceptance.

results.name: Recognizable diode, LED and capacitor terminals have badges and full inspector names
Hovering the K badge identifies the actual cathode lead rather than a nearby body
Clicking an A badge in connection mode selects that exact anode pad
Pin table searches by full electrical role, not just pin number
Printing can be disabled without losing editor identification; undo and redo work
Numeric/custom pins gain explicit roles without renumbering or copper/net changes
Printable size/gap/offsets survive real JSON download and file-input import
Rotation and side changes retain terminal identity and move printed symbols to the correct face
Fabrication defaults include silk and expose both silk-only inspection controls
Final top Gerber visibly retains the on-board line after all clear operations
Final bottom Gerber retains readable component-side markings in the flipped view
Viewer now correctly shows the old nested clear-frame reproducer as completely blank
Viewer unions overlapping dark contours even with reversed winding
The actual UI-generated ZIP contains the tested top and bottom Gerber text
Polarity controls remain reachable and labeled on a narrow screen
No external runtime requests or uncaught exceptions during the new workflows
